# squirrelscan

> The website QA tool for your coding agent. 310+ audit rules across SEO, performance, security, accessibility and agent experience.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/squirrelscan/squirrelscan): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://squirrelscan.com): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
